summary: End-to-end backend + frontend verification of TrustScore Next.js app. 20/20 backend pytest cases passing (auth, signup role whitelist, creator marketplace w/ filters/pagination, saved-creators isolation, collaboration lifecycle + authorization, messaging authorization, TrustScore audit incl. 401 unauth + 422 insufficient data). Frontend journey (login as sarah -> dashboard shows real seeded creators -> /creators lists 6 seeded creators with real DB data -> profile page -> Save Creator toggles to Saved -> Request Collaboration modal opens fully populated). No fake data observed. Design not tested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Card-level bookmark icons on creator cards lack a discoverable data-testid (e.g., data-testid="save-creator-<handle>"). Detail-page Save Creator button works but adding testids on marketplace cards would improve testability.
Collaboration modal lacks data-testid on its dialog root and fields; consider adding data-testid="collaborate-modal", data-testid="collab-campaign-title", etc.
POST /api/collaborations required-fields error is a generic 'Missing required collaboration fields' — consider naming which field(s) are missing for clearer client validation.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral signups prefixed with TEST_ (no cleanup implemented; harmless in dev). One collaboration and one message were created against seeded sarah->alex during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_trustscore.py. Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_trustscore.py -v`. Collaboration payload requires {creatorId, campaignName, budget, deliverables} (plus optional campaignDescription, timeline, contactEmail). Messages POST expects {collaborationId, text}. Session cookie is 'trustscore_session' (httpOnly). Public URL is same-origin for both UI and /api. Design was intentionally NOT verified.
